## Kill Chain v2.4.1 — Legal and Universal Output Repositioning

Universal Windows audio engine for headphones, speakers, and home theater.

### Highlights

- Fresh installs default to **Neutral** — no brand-specific correction assumed
- **Playback Correction** UX for headphones, speakers, soundbars, TVs, and home theater
- Trademark and content-responsibility notices in Settings › Advanced
- Proprietary LICENSE and third-party notices for commercial distribution prep

### Install

1. Download `Kill-Chain-Setup-2.4.1.exe` below
2. Run the installer (see SmartScreen note in README if Windows blocks it)
3. Launch from Start menu or desktop shortcut

### Requirements

Windows 10/11 (64-bit)

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/JerryKoller/Kill-Chain/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
